objective: Turn compose into a modal: /compose opens as an overlay over the current page from a floating + button that replaces the Compose nav item, with icon-only paperclip and bar-chart attach controls, and an image check that waits in place, attaches by itself when the image passes, and removes it with one red line when it is refused or takes over 30 s; the thread's reply box takes the same image flow.
acceptance_criteria: /compose is an overlay route, like the thread modal: a link to it from a page carries that page as its background, which stays mounted and unchanged underneath (its DOM, state and scroll, as BackgroundRoutes keeps a page under the detail modal); a link to it from inside the detail modal carries the flow's background, so the detail closes under it and Close returns to the detail; a direct load or a reload of any /compose address opens it over the feed. The dialog is UI-010's Dialog (components/ui/Dialog), titled "Compose", one dialog at a time, never stacked on the detail modal.

Ways out: Close, Escape and the backdrop go back one history entry when the entry was opened by an in-app link, and otherwise replace the entry with / (so nothing before the app's first entry is ever reached); browser Back closes it the same way; focus returns to what opened it, or, when compose was opened inside the detail modal (whose opener is gone by then), to the detail's Close button when the detail returns. All of this is read from history state by routes/modal-flow.tsx, which stays the one module that reads it (it already has flowOf and isLocation); the compose dialog and the link helpers use its hooks.

The guard's rules are unchanged: /compose still needs an active account. A signed-out visitor who loads a /compose address is sent to /sign-in with the address as `from`, and a profile-less account to /create-profile, with no dialog shown first; while the account is still loading, and for a deactivated or unavailable account, what RequireAuth shows today is shown inside the dialog in place of the composer, never below the page underneath.

Every /compose address keeps working with the same meaning: ?reply_to=, ?repost_of= and FRONTEND-013's three ?link= forms (ComposeRoute.test.tsx and prefilled-link.test.tsx pass with only the changes the overlay itself needs, each named in the PR). FRONTEND-017's "Post about this" links on the game page, its box-score rows and the player page's career rows open the modal over the page they are on (or, inside the detail modal, over the flow's background), with the same addresses.

The + button: UI-010's FloatingButton with CirclePlusIcon and an accessible name "Compose a post", in its onClick form (its link form takes no history state), navigating to /compose with the current page as background; shown only to a signed-in active account (useAccount().status === "active"), on every page; the Compose item leaves the primary nav in the header and in the phone's bottom bar, and nothing else in the nav changes. While the compose modal is open the + is not in the tab order (the dialog is modal).

On phones the + sits above the bottom bar and clear of env(safe-area-inset-bottom) (FloatingButton's own CSS); main gains bottom padding so the last card's controls, its "More options" button included, can scroll fully clear of the + at 360 wide.

After a post is published the modal closes exactly as Close does, and every feed query is invalidated (the ["feed"] key prefix, spelled in compose as features/profile spells the teams key: compose imports no other feature), so the feed shows the new post; a failed post keeps the draft and the modal open, as today.

Attach controls: a row of icon-only buttons under the text box, each at least 44 px square with an accessible name and a visible focus ring: a paperclip (PaperclipIcon, "Attach an image") that opens the file chooser of a visually hidden file input (no accept attribute, as today), and a bar chart (ChartColumnIcon, "Attach stats") that shows and hides today's AttachmentPicker panel in place (aria-expanded, aria-controls), closed by default; FRONTEND-021 replaces the panel with the picker modal. A link already attached, from the picker or a pre-filled address, shows its summary whether the panel is open or not. A reply address offers no stats button, as it offers no Attach stats today.

Image check: after a file is chosen, a tile of fixed size takes its place in the draft at once, through the upload and the check alike, showing the file name, covered by a static overlay (no animation, accessibility.md A8; the shared Skeleton fill or equivalent) with a status line "Checking the image…" in a role="status" region; when the pipeline answers processed, the thumbnail replaces the tile and the image is attached with no second press, with a remove control (CircleXIcon, "Remove image"); Post is disabled while an image is being checked.

Refusal: a type the client refuses, a file larger than the ticket's max_bytes, a rejected status, or no processed status within 30 s of the upload to the bucket finishing (the human, 2026-10-24: a slow connection never fails a good image) each remove the tile, attach nothing and show one red line with a CircleXIcon reading exactly "The image you attached is too large or cannot be accepted" (InlineAlert or equivalent, announced); choosing another file clears it. The 30 s bound is the client's: at the bound one last poll is made before refusing (a hidden tab's paused poll must not refuse an image that was processed, R17), polling stops after it and at any terminal status, no poll is made after the bound or after the composer closes, and the media row is left as it is (an unattached row is already the normal case, 0x04-media.md). A failure to reach the API or the bucket keeps today's "We could not upload that image. Please try again." line.

The thread's reply box (InlineComposer) uses the same image control with the same behaviour (the human, 2026-10-24); its own layout and the thread's cards and layout are otherwise unchanged (no file under features/thread/ or features/feed/ changes).

Lazy and light: the compose dialog's content stays its own lazy chunk (ComposePage, or what replaces it), waited for behind a loading line inside the dialog, never the page's Suspense, so opening compose never blanks the page underneath; lazy-routes.test.ts pins it.

Baseline (declared by the skeptic, 2026-10-24; before figures from origin/main 041e1c1 as bundle-budget.test.ts's own build measures them, gzip by zlib at the default level): (a) no new dependency; (b) bundle, pinned by frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/FRONTEND-020.ts (R12): entryJsGzipGrowth at most 1000 (the skeptic's prototype measured +807: the overlay and the + +460, MediaWidget's new flow +360), entryJsRawGrowth at most 3500 (prototype +2,907), entryCssGzipGrowth at most 300 (prototype +222), and the entry under 480 kB raw (R1); the compose JS chunk(s) at most 5.6 kB gzip together (before: ComposePage 5,177; prototype 5,303) and the compose stylesheet(s) at most 0.7 kB (before 576); every other lazy chunk unchanged; no chunk 500,000 bytes raw or more; the before and after build tables are in the PR body; (c) requests, pinned with msw request counts in tests: opening the modal makes 0 API calls (1 for a pre-filled ?link= address, as today), the + and the nav make none, and one image makes 1 ticket request, 1 bucket upload and at most 31 GET /media/{id} polls (one each second from the upload's end, the last at the bound), and none after the bound; publishing from the feed with 2 pages loaded makes 1 POST /posts and 2 GET /feed, and nothing else; (d) no freeze, recorded in the PR body (Chromium Performance panel, CPU throttled 4x, 360 wide, vite preview against backend-dev): with at least 40 cards loaded on the feed (every card reads the location, so all of them re-render on open and close), on opening the modal (chunk cold and warm), on closing it and on choosing a file, the median long task over five alternating runs per side is at most 200 ms and no run is over 250 ms (R4, R14); (e) cumulative layout shift under 0.1, in the worst of five runs, on the page underneath while the modal opens (measured with network throttled to "Fast 4G" or slower, so the chunk lands outside the 500 ms input window) and closes, inside the dialog while the image tile turns into a thumbnail, and when a refused tile gives way to the red line (30 s after any input, so it counts); (f) every existing frontend test passes; typecheck, lint and build pass.

Sibling hygiene with FRONTEND-018: 0x08-frontend.md gets a section of its own for this unit, appended, and the PR names any shared test-kit file under src/test/ it edits (server.ts, app-route.tsx, render.tsx and the like). 0x08-frontend.md records the compose overlay (its history state, its ways out, the direct-load rule), the + button and its visibility rule, the attach row, and the image check with its 30 s bound and exact refusal line (FrontendUI/components.md rows go in a Director PR: no unit role may write FrontendUI/).

Browser rows (vite preview against backend-dev, light and dark, 360 and 1280 wide, signed in with the test accounts): the + opens compose over the feed, a profile, Stats and a game page, each left as it was after Close, Escape, a backdrop click and browser Back; a direct load and a reload of /compose open it over the feed; posting closes it and the post is at the top of the feed; "Post about this" from the game page and from a game opened in the detail modal opens compose, and Close returns to where it was; signed out the + is absent and /compose goes to sign-in; at 360 the + clears the bottom bar and the last card's "More options" can be scrolled clear of it; the paperclip and bar-chart controls work by keyboard; an image left pending (local dev has no GuardDuty) shows the checking tile and, after 30 s, the red line; an image set to processed in the dev database while pending attaches by itself; the reply box in a thread shows the same flow.
